description: Entitlement-only policy for a synthetic oracle control. States who may receive the protected reward mint and which obligation each authorization must discharge alongside it. States no verdict.

roles.holder: the account presenting the credential proof
roles.mint_recipient: the account entitled to the minted reward
roles.treasury: the account the required fee obligation must be paid to

required_obligations.description: each authorization that mints the reward must also commit the fee to the treasury
